disposition_reason: Table 1 prints range and mean ± SD (µg/g wet weight) of Pb, Cd, Hg, Zn, Cu and Cr for six processed pork meat products bought in Apulia, Italy.

study.design: Retail survey of 100 processed pork meat products (6 product types) with intake, hazard-quotient and cancer-risk estimates
study.market: Most important commercial centers of the Apulian region, South Italy
study.method: HNO3-HClO4 (8:3) wet digestion for Cd, Pb, Zn, Cu, Cr and H2SO4-HNO3 (1:1) for Hg; AAS (flame for Zn; graphite furnace for Cd, Pb, Cr, Cu; hydride/cold-vapor generator for Hg)
study.lod_text: LOD Hg 5, Cd 0.12, Pb 10, Zn 24, Cu 26, Cr 5 ng/g wet weight; LOQ Hg 13, Cd 0.40, Pb 0.38, Zn 87, Cu 81, Cr 16 ng/g wet weight (as printed)
study.qa: NIST SRM 1577c bovine liver, recoveries 93-108% (n = 3); spike recoveries 96-99%; duplicate analyses, RSD < 10%; two blanks per batch

unresolved: Printed Pb LOQ (0.38 ng/g) is below the printed Pb LOD (10 ng/g); one of the two limits is likely misprinted.
Detection shares (Cd detected in 75% of samples, Hg undetectable in 40%, 6% of samples near the Cd limit, 9% at the Hg guidance) are not recorded as findings.
Table 2 compares literature values from other countries; not extracted (quotes of other studies).
Abstract Hg range (0.01-0.02 µg/g) refers to product means; per-sample maximum in Table 1 is 0.05 µg/g.
